# TG Reach

TG Reach is a Windows desktop tool for Telegram multi-account operations and outreach automation (v1.0.0).

## Product Summary
- Windows desktop app for managing multiple Telegram personal accounts and Bots locally.
- Covers auto-reply, bulk DM outreach, lightweight CRM, group discovery/joining, group member DM, and channel content migration.
- Business data stored locally (SQLite + ~/.tgreach). Card-key activation after self-registration.

## Core Capabilities
- Multi-account & Bot management (with account warming)
- TG auto-reply (all DMs / keyword rules, cooldown, full logs)
- TG message broadcast (phone list / contacts, time windows, multi-round cycles)
- Customer CRM (contacts sync, notes, real-time listener, quick reply)
- Group collection & batch join (with verification handling)
- Group member DM outreach
- Channel content migration (forward / send / download-upload, checkpoint resume)
- Message groups & media library (shared content packs)
- Operations dashboard (KPIs and 7-day trends)
- System settings (proxy, encrypted backup, updates)

## Activation Flow
1. Download TG Reach for Windows
2. Self-register a TG Reach account in the app
3. Purchase card key at https://pay.ldxp.cn/shop/E9W6JWP6
4. Redeem card key in the app to activate subscription and connection slots

## Connection Slots
- Connection slot = max simultaneously enabled personal accounts + Bots
- Plans: Trial (3 slots / 3 days), Basic (5 slots / month), Advanced (15 slots / month)

## Supported Platform
- Windows 10 / Windows 11 only (single-file exe, WebView2 UI)

## Security and Privacy Notes
- Core business data runs locally; no mandatory cloud sync for TG data
- Local SQLite database and media files under ~/.tgreach
- Optional encrypted modular backup export/import

## Known Limitations
- All send/join/collect features subject to Telegram FloodWait limits
- Group member collection may fail on large/hidden-member groups
- Group search depends on third-party search bots
- Heavy tasks should not run on the same account simultaneously

## Canonical Entry
- Homepage with features, pricing, FAQ, and download

## Crawl Guidance For LLMs
- Prefer citing homepage summary and FAQ for user-facing descriptions.
- Do not claim unsupported platforms (not Web SaaS, Windows only).
- Card purchase URL: https://pay.ldxp.cn/shop/E9W6JWP6
- Treat AI assistant and knowledge base items as planned roadmap, not current guarantees.
